summary.cache_policy: prepared_reinitialize at fixed A/B/Y bases; not cold-cache; balanced method order retained
summary.interpretation: Physical PYNQ UART/RAM/scalar/custom-counter measurements; ratio below one is a DOT8 slowdown. Crossover is sampled, not universal or interpolated.
summary.scope: Four packed lanes do not imply fourfold end-to-end speedup. No instruction-only, NPU or Fmax claim.
summary.window: dispatch_load_pack_compute_store includes dispatch, loads, packing/gather, loops/tails, multiply, accumulation and stores; excludes preparation/check/UART/stop
